title: The Ghost of Bongcheon-Dong Horror Webtoon Gets Live-Action Film Adaptation
content: Horang's horror webtoon The Ghost of Bongcheon-Dong is being adapted into a live-action film. Lotte Entertainment announced on October 7 that Arin — a member of K-pop girl group OH MY GIRL — and Chan-young Yoon will star in the film. Production began on October 5.
author: ANN

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Drops to #4, Star Detective Precure! Film to #5 in Japan
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #2 to #4 in its 11th weekend in Japan's box office from last Friday to Sunday. The film earned 178,447,600 yen (about US$1.12 million).
author: ANN

title: How I Became King by Eating Monsters Novels Get TV Anime by White Fox in 2027
content: Anime studio WHITE FOX announced on Friday it is producing a television anime adaptation of Daken 's How I Became King by Eating Monsters ( Monster no Niku wo Kutteitara Ōi ni Tsuita Ken ) light novel series. The anime will debut in 2027.
author: ANN

title: White Fox Produces 'Monster no Niku wo Kutte Itara Oui ni Tsuita Ken' TV Anime Adaptation for 2027
content: Production company King Records opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Daken 's Monster no Niku wo Kutte Itara Oui ni Tsuita Ken ( How I Became King by Eating Monsters ) light novel on Friday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Girls und Panzer Franchise Gets 2 New Games
content: D3Publisher and G Holdings each announced a new game for the Girls und Panzer franchise on Friday. D3Publisher is developing the Girls und Panzer : All-Star Tank Carnival game, while G Holdings is developing the Girls und Panzer : Bokosuka Rush game.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll, HAYATE, LINE Digital Frontier Partner to Produce Anime of 'Around' 15 Webtoons
content: Crunchyroll will exclusively stream the anime made through this partnership in select territories. HAYATE Inc. was founded in March 2025 and is headquartered in Tokyo. Aniplex 's Masanori Miyake leads the venture as Chairman and CEO along with President and COO Leo Watanabe .
author: ANN

title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, January Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of author Kennoji and artist R_ringo 's My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! ( Dōkyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishō ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase Desu ) manga unveiled a teaser promotional video on Friday.

title: Animator Kenichirou Katsura Dies at 59
content: Kenichirou Katsura , known for his character designs for Macross 7 and Knight's & Magic , died on September 30. He was 59. A funeral service was held by his close relatives.
